name: docker-tcp
description: Connect Podman Desktop to Docker engines reachable via tcp:// (e.g. Docker in WSL on tcp://127.0.0.1:2375)

dockerTcp.endpoints.markdownDescription: Docker engines to connect, separated by `;`. Format: `name=tcp://host:port`, e.g. `WSL Docker=tcp://127.0.0.1:2375; Server=tcp://127.0.0.1:23750`
